tonight.headline: Boston's claim locks overnight — and two lineup fixes are still undone
body: Bad news first: AVIATO are 3-6, Garrett Wilson is still in the concussion protocol, Etienne's window has not opened, and Arizona just lost Minshew to a torn UCL, leaving Allgeier behind Carson Beck.
Week 10 is Nicky Jam, 123.7 to 100.7 as set and 63% on ESPN. The projection lineup adds 8.9. The Boston claim must be in before 02:00 Wednesday Mexico City time — tonight.

case.label: The swing
case.body: Warren for Allgeier is 6.9 of the 8.9; Wilson for Diggs the other 2.0, with Metcalf as cover.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McCarthy ruled out Thursday would cut Likely and the Giants D/ST together; Wilson ruled out Friday turns the WR swap into Metcalf or Boston.

doFirst.title: Claim Denzel Boston tonight
doFirst.subtitle: Drop Alvin Kamara. The window closes at 02:00 Wednesday Mexico City time — this is the last brief before it does.

case.label: The player
case.body: Cleveland's target leader: 8, 11 and 7 targets in Weeks 7-9 (archive), 15.8 points in Week 9. On waivers, 78.6% rostered across ESPN — Chem's other managers let him go.

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: The Browns are 'planning for him to start Sunday' — Deshaun Watson, per Jeremy Fowler (DK Network 10 Nov). NBC/Yahoo the same day say Monken declined to name a starter Monday. Boston's best week (11 targets, Week 8) came with Watson.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Kamara, 63.5% rostered — disagreeing with the market on the record: 6 carries to Estime's 15 in Week 9 (archive), and he is fourth among AVIATO's backs by projection (10.3). Yahoo/NBC 10 Nov read him as the Saints' lead back until Etienne returns; the archive says Estime took the early downs. I take the archive. Etienne is not the drop: his thesis runs to Week 11 and has not tripped. Allgeier is on the screen's exposure list.

case.label: This week
case.body: Boston 12.8 sits level with Wilson and above Metcalf 11.2 and Diggs 10.8, so he is the WR2 if Wilson is not cleared. Cleveland's bye is Week 11. Chem priority resets weekly — the claim costs nothing lasting.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Boston draws under 5 targets with Watson starting in Week 10 (archive), or Kamara outscores him in two of Weeks 10, 12 and 13 wherever he lands.

doFirst.title: Start Garrett Wilson over Diggs
doFirst.subtitle: A 2.0-point projection gap — and Diggs plays Thursday, so this has to be set before Wilson's status is known.

case.label: The call
case.body: Lineup check: Wilson 12.8 over Diggs 10.8, labelled PROJECTION at exactly 2.0 — the edge of the coin-flip line, so it goes to the projection.

case.label: The risk, handled
case.body: Wilson is still in the concussion protocol (DK Network 10 Nov), though NBC/Yahoo 10 Nov expect him back for Week 10. If he is inactive at 10:30 Sunday, DK Metcalf (11.2, Sunday night) takes the slot — still above Diggs. Benching Diggs now costs nothing either way.

case.label: If Boston lands
case.body: Boston and Wilson are level at 12.8. Start Wilson if he is off the injury report by Friday; Boston if he is not. Diggs sits either way.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Diggs outscores the player who fills that WR slot (Wilson, or Metcalf/Boston if Wilson sits) in Week 10 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Warren at FLEX, bench Allgeier
doFirst.subtitle: 6.9 points of projection — still not done since this morning.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Warren 15.6 at Cincinnati, Allgeier 8.7 against the Rams — a PROJECTION gap, the biggest single fix on the roster.

case.label: Since this morning
case.body: Arizona got worse: Minshew has a torn UCL and Carson Beck is in line to start (Schefter via DK Network 10 Nov). Allgeier's share is intact — 17 of 17 back carries in Week 9 — but it is now behind a rookie-level passer.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier outscores Warren in Week 10 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup as set is 8.9 points below the projection lineup
whatWentWrong.lead: Allgeier at FLEX (8.7) and Diggs at WR (10.8) while Warren (15.6) and Wilson (12.8) sit. Nothing has changed since 07:00.

case.label: What it is
case.body: Two swaps, both in Do-first above. Week 9 was lost 97.96-141.12 with only 1.3 on the bench (archive) — the lineup was right then; it is not right now.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson ruled out by Friday — then the WR swap becomes Metcalf (or Boston) for Diggs, and the gap shrinks to about 7.3.
